chunks.rationale: Read this first — the whole bug and the whole fix are here. .changesPanel is a fixed max-height flex column with overflow: hidden, and .patchScroll was the only scroller. A tall itinerary consumed the 520px, .patchScroll collapsed to zero (flex items do not shrink below min-content), and .commitBox landed past the clipped bottom edge. The new .changesScroll takes flex: 1 / min-height: 0 / overflow-y: auto and carries gap: 10px to replace the spacing its children used to inherit from .changesPanel's own gap. flex-shrink: 0 on .changesHead and .commitBox is what actually guarantees the commit box can never be squeezed out again.
risks: position: sticky on .commitBox is inert as written: .changesScroll absorbs the flex space so .commitBox no longer overflows .changesPanel, and there is nothing to stick against. Harmless and requested by #555, but do not treat it as load-bearing — the flex-shrink rules are.
.changesScroll duplicates gap: 10px from .changesPanel. If someone later changes the panel gap the two will drift apart silently.

flex: 1 was removed from .patchScroll, so a very long diff now grows the scroller's content rather than fitting a flex track. Correct for this fix (the parent scrolls) but it changes how tall diffs lay out.

chunks.rationale: Only two real lines: the opening <div className={styles.changesScroll}> before <ReviewItineraryView> and its close after the diff.truncated note, with .commitBox deliberately left outside. Read with `git diff -w` — the other ~128 changed lines are pure re-indentation of the wrapped children and carry no logic.
risks:
The wrap must not swallow .commitBox. Verify by eye that the closing sits before
— nesting it inside would reintroduce the exact bug with a scrollbar instead of a clip.
The error/loading/empty paragraphs stay outside .changesScroll as direct panel children. Intentional, but it means a long error message is still unscrollable.

chunks.rationale: Regression coverage for a pure-layout failure that no behavioural assertion catches: one render test walking the ancestor chain from the commit textarea to prove it is not inside .changesScroll, plus a per-rule-block read of the stylesheet pinning flex-shrink: 0, overflow-y: auto and the absence of overflow: auto on .patchScroll.
risks: The CSS-text guard is only as good as its rule-block parsing — a whole-file `includes` would pass on a match in an unrelated rule and prove nothing.
CSS module class names may not resolve to usable strings in this harness; if the test falls back to asserting DOM structure it is weaker against a rename of .changesScroll.

jsdom does not lay out, so no test here can prove the commit box is actually visible at 520px — the CSS-text guard is a proxy. Confirming the real fix needs eyes on the running app with a tall itinerary.
Worker A's run was cancelled before it verified anything; tsc --noEmit and the 29 threadView tests were run by the orchestrator after merge, not by the author.
